# Project Rules & ECC Agent Instructions

Before starting any task, follow the ECC Task Inception Protocol:
1. Check available ECC skills and their descriptions.
2. Select ONLY the skills directly relevant to the current task. If an essential skill is excluded due to context budget limits, locate and read its `SKILL.md` directly.
3. Do NOT scan or load every skill file indiscriminately.
4. Do NOT spend time or tokens explaining skill selection unless a required skill is unavailable.
5. Proceed directly with the task workflow once relevant instructions are loaded.
